Location

There is currently one permanent whole-time vacancy available in HSeLanD, Leadership and Capability.

The General Manager is open to engagement with regards to the postholder being based in one of the following Leadership and Capability locations:

  • HR-Leadership and Capability, HSE, 2nd Floor, Clinical and Administration Block A, Merlin Park, University Hospital Galway.
  • HR-Leadership and Capability Offices, 4th Floor, 20-23 Merchants Quay, Dublin 8.
  • HR Leadership and Capability, HSE, Unit 8A, Burlington Business Park, Srah Avenue, Tullamore, Co. Offaly.
